title: Uncapped liability
text: The supplier's liability under this agreement is unlimited and has no maximum amount or cap.
suggested_revision: Cap total liability at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months, excluding fraud and wilful misconduct.

title: One-sided liability exclusion
text: The provider shall not be liable for any damages whatsoever, including loss of data, profits or business, even if caused by its own negligence.
suggested_revision: Make exclusions mutual and keep liability for gross negligence, data breaches and confidentiality breaches.

title: Broad one-way indemnity
text: The client shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the provider from every claim, loss or cost of any kind, regardless of who caused it.
suggested_revision: Limit indemnity to third-party claims caused by the indemnifying party's breach or negligence, and make it mutual.

title: Termination at will by counterparty
text: The company may end this agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, without giving notice.
suggested_revision: Require at least 30 days written notice and payment for all work completed up to termination.

title: No termination right for us
text: The customer may not terminate this agreement before the end of the term under any circumstances.
suggested_revision: Add a right to terminate for material breach not cured within 30 days.

title: Silent automatic renewal
text: This agreement will continue for successive terms unless one party cancels before the renewal date; it renews by default.
suggested_revision: Require written confirmation before renewal and a reminder 60 days before the renewal date.

title: Long renewal lock-in
text: Upon renewal the customer is committed for another three year term at the then-current prices.
suggested_revision: Limit renewal terms to 12 months with a price-increase cap.

title: Broad non-compete
text: After the agreement ends, the contractor must not work for any competitor or start a similar business anywhere in the world for five years.
suggested_revision: Limit to 12 months, a defined territory and directly competing services only.

title: Non-solicitation of staff and clients
text: The contractor may not approach, hire or do business with any employee or customer of the company for an extended period.
suggested_revision: Limit to 12 months and to people the contractor actually worked with.

title: Confidentiality that never ends
text: The obligation to keep information secret continues forever and has no end date.
suggested_revision: Limit confidentiality to 3-5 years after termination, except genuine trade secrets.

title: One-way confidentiality
text: Only the receiving party has to keep information confidential; the disclosing party has no such duty.
suggested_revision: Make confidentiality obligations mutual.

title: Unilateral price increase
text: The provider can raise its fees whenever it wants, and the customer must pay the new price.
suggested_revision: Limit increases to once a year, capped at CPI, with 60 days notice and a right to exit.

title: Very long payment terms
text: Invoices will be paid ninety days or more after they are received.
suggested_revision: Negotiate net 30 payment terms.

title: Excessive late-payment charges
text: Any late amount attracts heavy interest every month plus additional penalty charges.
suggested_revision: Cap interest at the statutory rate or 1% per month with no extra penalties.

title: Fees never refunded
text: All amounts paid are final and will not be returned even if the service is not delivered.
suggested_revision: Allow pro-rata refunds when the agreement ends due to the provider's breach.

title: Total IP assignment
text: Everything the contractor creates, including tools and know-how they owned before, becomes the exclusive property of the company.
suggested_revision: Exclude pre-existing IP and give the company a licence to it instead of ownership.

title: Customer data owned by vendor
text: The vendor owns all data uploaded to the platform and may use it for any purpose.
suggested_revision: State that the customer owns its data and the vendor may use it only to provide the service.

title: No warranty at all
text: The product is supplied as it is, with no promise that it will work or be fit for any purpose.
suggested_revision: Add a 90-day warranty that the service materially conforms to its documentation.

title: Waiver of court rights
text: The customer gives up the right to a jury trial and to join any class or group lawsuit.
suggested_revision: Remove the waiver or make it mutual and limited to small claims.

title: Remote or one-sided venue
text: All disputes must be heard only in the courts of a distant foreign country chosen by the provider.
suggested_revision: Use the customer's home jurisdiction or a neutral seat of arbitration.

title: Unilateral amendment
text: The provider may change the terms of this agreement at any time by posting new terms, and continued use means acceptance.
suggested_revision: Require written agreement of both parties for any change to the contract.

title: Decisions at one party's sole discretion
text: The company decides entirely on its own judgement, without needing to give reasons, whether the work is acceptable.
suggested_revision: Use objective acceptance criteria and 'reasonable discretion exercised in good faith'.

title: Penalty / liquidated damages
text: If a deadline is missed the contractor must pay a large fixed sum for every day of delay, whatever the actual loss.
suggested_revision: Make liquidated damages a genuine pre-estimate of loss and cap them at 10% of fees.

title: Assignment without consent
text: The provider may transfer this agreement to any other company without asking the customer.
suggested_revision: Require prior written consent for assignment, not to be unreasonably withheld.

title: Suspension without notice
text: The provider can suspend or cut off the service immediately and without warning if it believes there is a problem.
suggested_revision: Require notice and a chance to fix the issue before suspension, except for genuine security emergencies.
